sections.title: Cave of Ordeals
sections.note: Gerudo Mesa, beside the warp point. Clear every enemy to open each floor's exit; a Great Fairy waits every tenth floor.

items.name: Floor 1
items.howTo: Enemies: 1 Bokoblin.
items.after: Gerudo Desert (Bridge of Eldin piece warped back)
items.notes: The entrance is beside the Gerudo Mesa warp point, uncovered once Midna warps the stray Bridge of Eldin segment home.

items.name: Floor 2
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Rats and 3 Keese.

items.name: Floor 3
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Baba Serpents: kill the one on the floor first, then drop the hanging ones with the Gale Boomerang.
items.notes: A Heart is buried here (Wolf digging spot).

items.name: Floor 4
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Skulltulas.

items.name: Floor 5
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Bulblins (Bulblin Archers in some guides).

items.name: Floor 6
items.howTo: Enemies: 9 Torch Slugs: Clawshot the ones on the ceiling down before you drop in.

items.name: Floor 7
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Dodongos and 5 Fire Keese.
items.notes: Three Hearts are buried here.

items.name: Floor 8
items.howTo: Enemies: 6 Tektites (2 blue, 4 red).

items.name: Floor 9
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Bulblin Archers and Lizalfos (2 or 4 by source).

items.name: Floor 10: Great Fairy
items.howTo: The Great Fairy's fountain: talk to her.
items.notes: The Great Fairy hints at the next item needed (the Spinner) and can return you to the surface. HD: the Surprised Link stamp is here.

items.name: Floor 11
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Helmasaurs and about 13 Rats. Ride the Spinner to reach the exit.

items.name: Floor 12
items.howTo: Enemies: 1 large Purple Chu, which splits; you can fight it from the ledge with the Clawshot.

items.name: Floor 13
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Chu Worms: Clawshot them out of their bubbles.

items.name: Floor 14
items.howTo: Enemies: 15 Bubbles: Wolf area attack or Spin Attack hits several at once.
items.notes: An Orange Rupee (100) is buried here.

items.name: Floor 15
items.howTo: Enemies: 10 Bulblins.

items.name: Floor 16
items.howTo: Enemies: 6 Rats and 6 Keese (8 and 8 in some guides).

items.name: Floor 17
items.howTo: Enemies: 10 Stalhounds and an Imp Poe: kill the Stalhounds first, then the Poe as a wolf with senses.
items.notes: One of the three Imp Poes in the cave; it doesn't return once beaten.

items.name: Floor 18
items.howTo: Enemies: 8 Leevers (10 by some counts): a Spin Attack in the middle of the ring clears them.
items.notes: A Heart is buried here.

items.name: Floor 19
items.howTo: Enemies: A swarm of Chus (about 36 Purple plus Yellow, Red and Blue ones) that merge into big ones.
items.notes: A Rare Chu may appear.

items.name: Floor 20: Great Fairy
items.howTo: The Great Fairy's fountain: talk to her.
items.notes: The next ordeal needs the Ball and Chain. HD: the Angry Zelda stamp is here.

items.name: Floor 21
items.howTo: Enemies: 5 Bokoblins and 5 Ice Keese. Smash the way out with the Ball and Chain.

items.name: Floor 22
items.howTo: Enemies: 5 Keese, 7 Rats and 10 Ghoul Rats; the Ghoul Rats can only be seen and hit by the wolf with senses on.
items.notes: Three Hearts are buried in the centre.

items.name: Floor 23
items.howTo: Enemies: About 25 Stalkin: swing the Ball and Chain downward to crush groups.

items.name: Floor 24
items.howTo: Enemies: 5 ReDead Knights (Gibdos): the Ball and Chain keeps them at a distance.

items.name: Floor 25
items.howTo: Enemies: Bulblins and Bulblin Archers (about 11): shoot the archer on the tower before you drop in.

items.name: Floor 26
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Stalfos: Bomb Arrows from the ledge, then the Ball and Chain to finish the bones.

items.name: Floor 27
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Skulltulas and 6 Bubbles: deal with the Bubbles first.
items.notes: A Heart is buried here.

items.name: Floor 28
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Lizalfos and 6 Bokoblins.

items.name: Floor 29
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Stalfos, 3 Fire Bubbles and about 12 Stalkin.

items.name: Floor 30: Great Fairy
items.howTo: The Great Fairy's fountain: talk to her.
items.notes: The next ordeal needs the Dominion Rod. HD: the Happy Midna stamp is here.

items.name: Floor 31
items.howTo: Enemies: 5 Beamos and 8 Keese: destroy the Beamos from the ledge, then move the two statues blocking the door with the Dominion Rod.

items.name: Floor 32
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Dodongos, 6 Torch Slugs, 6 Fire Keese and 6 Fire Bubbles: clear the ceiling slugs before dropping in.

items.name: Floor 33
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 ReDead Knights (Gibdos) and an Imp Poe: Ball and Chain the knights, then the Poe as a wolf.

items.name: Floor 34
items.howTo: Enemies: 10 Ghoul Rats plus Yellow, Red and 7 Purple Chus; the Ghoul Rats need wolf senses.
items.notes: A Heart is buried here.

items.name: Floor 35
items.howTo: Enemies: 1 Freezard and 6 Ice Keese: Gale Boomerang the Keese from the ledge, then smash the Freezard with the Ball and Chain.

items.name: Floor 36
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Chilfos (8 on later runs).

items.name: Floor 37
items.howTo: Enemies: Leevers, Bubbles and Ice Bubbles (8 Leevers, 4 of each Bubble by Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Floor 38
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Chilfos, 2 Freezards, 3 Ice Bubbles and 3 Ice Keese. The Magic Armor helps.

items.name: Floor 39
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Darknuts (3 on later runs). Fight them one at a time.
items.notes: A Silver Rupee (200) is buried here.

items.name: Floor 40: Great Fairy
items.howTo: The Great Fairy's fountain: talk to her.
items.reward: Fairies released to Lanayru Spring (Lake Hylia)
items.notes: The next ordeal needs the Double Clawshots. HD: the Heart Container stamp is here.

items.name: Floor 41
items.howTo: Enemies: 9 Armos. Wake them a few at a time; Double Clawshots are needed to reach the exit.

items.name: Floor 42
items.howTo: Enemies: 6 Baba Serpents and 6 Bokoblins.

items.name: Floor 43
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Lizalfos and 6 Bulblin Archers: shoot the archers from the ledge.

items.name: Floor 44
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Dynalfos and an Imp Poe: Bomb Arrows from the ledge, then the Poe as a wolf.

items.name: Floor 45
items.howTo: Enemies: Bulblin Archers on towers, 5 ReDead Knights (Gibdos) and a mix of Chus.
items.notes: Three Hearts are buried here.

items.name: Floor 46
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Chilfos, 2 Freezards (one under the ledge) and 10 Ghoul Rats that need wolf senses.

items.name: Floor 47
items.howTo: Enemies: 1 Bokoblin, about 10 Stalkin and 10-17 Rats.

items.name: Floor 48
items.howTo: Enemies: 1 Darknut and 2 Aeralfos: take out the Aeralfos first.

items.name: Floor 49
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Darknuts (4 on later runs). Bombs held until they flash strip their armour; the Magic Armor helps.
items.notes: HD: the Fairy stamp. On a second full run the Postman squats on the last ledge reading a letter.

items.name: Floor 50: Great Fairy
items.howTo: The final Great Fairy: talk to her for her blessing.
items.reward: Great Fairy's Tears (fills an empty Bottle)
items.notes: After this every Spirit Spring refills a Bottle with Great Fairy's Tears whenever you carry none. You are returned to Lanayru Spring.

sections.title: HD Cave of Shadows
sections.note: Twilight Princess HD only, opened with the Wolf Link amiibo. 40 floors as Wolf Link, in three runs (to 6, to 20, to 40).

items.name: Floor 1
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Shadow Beasts.
items.notes: Scan the Wolf Link amiibo on the Collection screen. Link stays a wolf the whole way and bottled fairies won't revive him.

items.name: Floor 2
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Shadow Beasts.

items.name: Floor 3
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Shadow Deku Babas and 4 Shadow Vermin.

items.name: Floor 4
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Shadow Keese and 4 Shadow Vermin.

items.name: Floor 5
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Shadow Beasts and 4 Shadow Vermin.

items.name: Floor 6: chest and exit
items.howTo: A chest, then the way out. The first run ends here; leave and scan the amiibo again to go on.
items.notes: A Heart can be dug up in the middle of the room.

items.name: Floor 7
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Bokoblins (blue).

items.name: Floor 8
items.howTo: Enemies: 8 Keese.

items.name: Floor 9
items.howTo: Enemies: 6 Baba Serpents.
items.notes: A Heart can be dug up in the middle of the room.

items.name: Floor 10
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Helmasaurs.

items.name: Floor 11
items.howTo: Enemies: 9 Torch Slugs.

items.name: Floor 12
items.howTo: Enemies: 6 Tektites.

items.name: Floor 13
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Bulblin Archers.
items.notes: A Heart can be dug up in the middle of the room.

items.name: Floor 14
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Dodongos.

items.name: Floor 15
items.howTo: Enemies: 20 Chus.

items.name: Floor 16
items.howTo: Enemies: 15 Ghoul Rats.

items.name: Floor 17
items.howTo: Enemies: 15 Bubbles.

items.name: Floor 18
items.howTo: Enemies: 26 Stalkin.

items.name: Floor 19
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 ReDead Knights (Gibdos) and 55 Poison Mites.

items.name: Floor 20: chest and exit
items.howTo: A chest, then the way out. The second run ends here; you must replay floors 1-19 to reach floor 21.
items.notes: A Heart can be dug up in the middle of the room.

items.name: Floor 21
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Skulltulas and 5 Deku Babas.

items.name: Floor 22
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Helmasaurs and 12 Ghoul Rats.

items.name: Floor 23
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Lizalfos, 6 Bokoblins and 4 Armos.

items.name: Floor 24
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 ReDead Knights (Gibdos) and 8 Deku Babas.

items.name: Floor 25
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Dodongos, 14 Torch Slugs and 6 Fire Keese.

items.name: Floor 26
items.howTo: Enemies: 5 Keese, 5 blue Bokoblins and 10 Ghoul Rats.

items.name: Floor 27
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Bulblin Archers and 3 ReDead Knights (Gibdos).
items.notes: A Heart can be dug up in the middle of the room.

items.name: Floor 28
items.howTo: Enemies: 6 Ice Keese and 8 White Wolfos.

items.name: Floor 29
items.howTo: Enemies: 12 Chus and 12 Ghoul Rats.

items.name: Floor 30
items.howTo: Enemies: 1 Chilfos, 5 Mini Freezards and 7 Ice Keese.

items.name: Floor 31
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Armos, 10 Baby Gohmas, 6 Keese and 7 Rats.

items.name: Floor 32
items.howTo: Enemies: 1 Dynalfos, 1 Lizalfos and 2 Bokoblins.
items.notes: A Heart can be dug up in the middle of the room.

items.name: Floor 33
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Chilfos, 4 Mini Freezards and 7 Ice Keese.

items.name: Floor 34
items.howTo: Enemies: 11 Chus, 3 Lizalfos and 1 Dynalfos.

items.name: Floor 35
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Helmasaurs, 5 Deku Babas and 10 Keese.

items.name: Floor 36
items.howTo: Enemies: 2 Shadow Bulblin archers and 6 Shadow Bulblins.

items.name: Floor 37
items.howTo: Enemies: 4 Zant Masks and 4 Shadow Keese.

items.name: Floor 38
items.howTo: Enemies: 3 Bulblin Archers and 4 Bokoblins.
items.notes: A Heart can be dug up in the middle of the room.

items.name: Floor 39
items.howTo: Enemies: in phases: 2 Dodongos and 4 Baba Serpents; then 2 Fire Bubbles, 2 Ice Bubbles and 6 Stalkin; then 3 Zant Masks; then four switches, each calling its own group (Dynalfos, Lizalfos, Bulblins and Bokoblins, Skulltulas and Baby Gohmas).

items.name: Floor 40: Great Fairy and Wolf statue
items.howTo: The Great Fairy gives a wallet upgrade, then a door opens on a giant Wolf Link statue. A Silver Rupee chest is here, and an Orange Rupee is dug up on the statue's head.
items.reward: Colossal Wallet (9,999 Rupees) if you hold the Giant Wallet; otherwise the next wallet size
items.notes: Without the Giant Wallet you get the next size up, and Agitha's last reward becomes the Colossal Wallet.
